title: Fix registration error + surface real Supabase errors
description: Registration on production fails with 'Something went wrong. notes: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED via live log capture: register.lookup_failed -> Supabase 'Invalid API key', hint 'might be owned by another Supabase project'. NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL on Vercel is correct (https://gcsgctfbgpihxmqqlxch.supabase.co) but SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY value is wrong/from a different project, so every admin-client query is rejected. FIX (user-owned, secret): copy service_role key from project gcsgctfbgpihxmqqlxch -> set SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY on Vercel Production -> redeploy -> retry. No code change needed; logging instrumentation stays.

title: Admin function to reset a player's PIN
description: Production login for player 'Jake' (+919822027020, id f818e593-a95c-4bff-b5e5-9c29f0811244) fails with 'Invalid phone number or PIN'. DB facts (verified via Supabase Mgmt API on hosted project gcsgctfbgpihxmqqlxch): player IS registered, is_active=true, pin_hash is a well-formed scrypt hash (scrypt$16384..., 6 parts, len 86), created 2026-06-07 17:27 UTC. Code (pin.ts hashPin/verifyPin) is correct and symmetric, no env pepper. So the only cause is a PIN mismatch (entered PIN != PIN set at registration). There is NO PIN-reset/forgot-PIN flow. NEXT: build a reusable admin PIN-reset (reset, do not delete). Likely a scripts/admin-reset-pin.mjs that hashes a new 4-digit PIN with the same scrypt params and UPDATEs players.pin_hash by normalized phone, run with prod SUPABASE_URL + SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Note: prod service-role key is marked Sensitive in Vercel so 'vercel env pull' returns it blank; get it from Supabase Dashboard. Admin client pattern: src/lib/supabase/admin.ts. Deleting the row to re-register is a fallback but a PIN reset is cleaner (preserves id/history).
close_reason: Not needed — Jake's login worked fine (it was a PIN typo, not a bug; the account is registered, active, with a valid scrypt hash). A general forgot-PIN/admin-reset flow can be revisited under Helper-1j2 (Admin section) if wanted later.

title: Order-of-arrival points engine
description: Implement the locked algorithm: S = players who self-report an arrival rank for a session, N=|S|. Confirmation pts: among S sort by confirmation rank, k-th gets (N-k+1)*100, no-shows drop out & shift up; confirmation denominator excludes arrived-but-never-confirmed (their conf pts=0). Arrival pts: sort S by arrival rank, same formula. Ranks order-only, not literal multiplier. Ties = standard SKIP (500,500,300). Provisional until session Finalized.

title: iOS/Apple: app slow unless opened directly in Safari — investigate + guide note
description: User reports Apple users find the PWA (kfandra-track.vercel.app, next-pwa service worker) slow unless they 'download the link directly to their mobile devices'. Hypothesis: links opened via in-app browsers (WhatsApp/Gmail webview) on iOS don't share Safari's service-worker cache, so every open re-fetches uncached -> slow; opening in real Safari + Add to Home Screen uses the cached PWA. JACARANDA order-points + submit-flow rules (locked 2026-06-07). ORDER POINTS: S = players who self-report an ARRIVAL rank for the session (= those who showed); N=|S|. Confirmation points: among S, sort by self-reported confirmation rank; k-th gets (N-k+1)*100; no-shows drop out, everyone below shifts up. Arrival points: sort S by arrival rank; k-th gets (N-k+1)*100. Ranks used only to ORDER, not as literal multiplier. TIES = standard SKIP ranking (500,500,300). Arrived-but-never-confirmed: gets 0 confirmation pts and is NOT counted in the confirmation denominator (confirmation N = confirmed-and-arrived count, may be < arrival N). Order is self-reported (trust-based, no approval). SUBMIT FLOW = HYBRID: local autosave drafts (offline-safe, Option A); a lightweight 'Finalize/Done' action per MMG/Gym session (NOT an approval gate) that flushes to server, signals order-N computation, and is the nudge target. Diet = pure continuous current-day autosave, no finalize (not scored). N for order points provisional until session finalized.
